decisions.reason: Product A builds closely on the firm's established airport security and technology capabilities, and the firm's in-house R&D provides the absorptive capacity to interpret early results and improve it, so dropping is unlikely.

As a passenger processing technology closely related to the firm's existing security and technology offerings, the firm can apply its absorptive capacity to learn from early results and enhance it, making a drop improbable.

The self-service check-in solution leverages the firm's established airport operational and technology knowledge, enabling the firm to interpret results and improve the product through its absorptive capacity, so we keep it.
